settings.headline:
Tolerance is
everything.
settings.copy: Meridian Precision is a CNC machining shop for engineers who can't afford a bad part. From one-off prototypes to production runs of fifty thousand, we hold tolerances to a tenth of a thousandth — and we prove it with a full inspection report on every single piece that leaves the floor.

trust_list.text: CNC milling, turning, and 5-axis machining in-house
Tolerances to ±0.0001" with full CMM inspection reports
Prototype to production, one shop, one point of contact

settings.title: From prototype
settings.intro: One shop for the whole journey. We take your part from a napkin sketch or a CAD file to a finished, inspected, ready-to-assemble component — at any volume.

design.title: CNC milling & turning
design.text: Vertical and horizontal machining centers plus CNC lathes with live tooling. We cut aluminum, steel, stainless, titanium, and engineering plastics to spec.

design.title: Tight-tolerance work
design.text: When the print calls for ±0.0001", we hold it. Our CMM and surface-finish lab verify every critical dimension before the part ships.

build.title: 5-axis machining
build.text: For complex geometries that would take five setups on a 3-axis, our 5-axis centers cut them in one. Fewer setups, tighter accuracy, faster turnaround.

build.title: Hard materials
build.text: Inconel, titanium, hardened tool steel — we have the tooling, the speeds, and the feeds to machine the materials that break lesser shops.

launch.title: Prototyping
launch.text: Get a functional part in days, not weeks. We iterate fast so you can validate your design before you commit to tooling and volume.

launch.title: Production runs
launch.text: From a hundred to a hundred thousand, we run repeatable, documented production with in-process inspection and full traceability.

settings.title: The part is
settings.intro: Anyone can quote a part. We deliver the part — measured, documented, and on time. Here's what that actually means for your project.

features.title: Inspection on every part
features.text: Every piece gets a CMM or gauge inspection with a report you can hand to your own QA. No 'trust us' — just data.

features.title: Engineers who read prints
features.text: Our machinists are GD&T-literate. We catch tolerance and datum issues before they become scrap, and we flag them to you.

features.title: One shop, no handoffs
features.text: Milling, turning, finishing, and inspection all under one roof. No parts lost between vendors, no finger-pointing.

features.title: On-time, every time
features.text: We quote realistic lead times and hit them. 99.7% on-time delivery, backed by a schedule we actually control.

features.title: Material traceability
features.text: Every lot is tied to its material certs. If you need to trace a part back to the bar it came from, we can.

features.title: ISO 9001:2015
features.text: A certified quality system means repeatable process, documented controls, and an audit trail your customers will appreciate.

settings.title: From print
settings.intro: A disciplined, documented path that turns your drawing into a measured, shippable component. Here's what to expect at every step.

steps.title: Quote & review
steps.text: Send us your print or CAD. We review the geometry, flag any issues, and return a firm quote with a realistic lead time — usually within 24 hours.

steps.title: Programming & setup
steps.text: Our programmers write the toolpaths, select the tooling, and set up the machine. Fixtures are designed to hold your part rigid and repeatable.

steps.title: Machining & inspection
steps.text: The part is cut, then measured. Critical dimensions go to the CMM; every part gets a documented inspection before it's approved.

steps.title: Finish & ship
steps.text: Deburring, finishing, and packaging to your spec. The part ships with its inspection report and material certs, ready to assemble.

settings.note: Most quotes are returned within one business day. Prototypes typically ship in 5–10 business days; production lead times depend on volume and material — we'll give you a firm date up front and hit it.

settings.title: Engineers who

settings.title: Questions we
settings.intro: Straight answers about tolerances, materials, lead times, and how to work with us.

items.question: What tolerances can you actually hold?
items.answer: On most machined features we hold ±0.001" as standard, and we routinely hold ±0.0001" on critical dimensions. We'll confirm the achievable tolerance against your material and geometry before quoting.

items.question: What materials do you machine?
items.answer: Aluminum, steel, stainless, titanium, Inconel, brass, copper, and engineering plastics like PEEK, Delrin, and nylon. If you're unsure whether a material is machinable, send it to us and we'll tell you.

items.question: Do you work with prototypes and one-offs?
items.answer: Absolutely. Prototyping is a core part of our business. We'll machine a single functional part so you can validate your design before committing to production volume.

items.question: How fast can I get a quote?
items.answer: Most quotes are returned within one business day. For complex multi-part assemblies or exotic materials, allow up to two business days. We'll always give you a firm number, not a range.

items.question: Do you provide inspection reports?
items.answer: Yes — every part ships with a documented inspection report, and critical dimensions are verified on our CMM. Material certs and full traceability are available on request.

settings.title: Send us
settings.intro: Upload a print or CAD file and tell us about your project. We'll review the geometry and get back to you within one business day with a firm quote and lead time. No obligation, no hard sell.
settings.location: Meridian Precision · 42 Industrial Parkway, Fabrication District

settings.blurb: A CNC machining shop for engineers who can't afford a bad part — tight tolerances, full inspection reports, and on-time delivery from prototype to production.
